statistics: Five physical seeds are the paired units; operations within one implementation are not independent placement samples. No population inference by default.
transaction: One simultaneous independent encoder request and decoder request carrying the same payload; combined codec boundary, not a serial encode-decode or SRAM access.
steady_state_window: Equal completed transactions, after reset and fill and before drain; half-open [start_ps,end_ps). Historical whole-trace energy remains separately labelled.
production_gate: P2-G00 must pass on matching standard-cell models, timing constructs and physical artifacts before production estimator experiments. Generic probes alone do not pass it.
